We need to call apply_template with molecule_smiles = initial_molecule: "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1" and template_id = "324324".
<thought>To obtain all possible precursor sets for the target molecule using template 324324, I will apply the template to the given SMILES. The apply_template tool returns each precursor combination as a SMILES string (reactants separated by “.”). I will split each result on “.” to produce a list of individual precursor SMILES, and then collect all such lists into the required list‑of‑lists format.
